local_frame: Weak perspective over the small decorative crest in the historic image only. X along the original parapet to image right; Y back, Z up. Origin on the parapet near the raised shaft.

period.scale_note: Geometry scales proportionally to the adopted one-storey height. Absolute metres are estimated.

limits: Four dark shade bands identify the undersides of four light shelf lips. Historical image measurements are uncertain by about 1–2 native pixels. Depth of the lip, detailed mast section, edge radius and the monochrome material tints are estimates. The flag and the unrecorded far sides are outside the light ornament fragment.
